I wrote `solve.py` in the working directory with `cafe_bill(items, member)`. There was no `./skills` folder, so there was nothing to read first.

The function works in integer satang throughout. It applies the 5% discount when the subtotal is at least 50,000 satang (500 baht), then the 10% member discount on the discounted amount, then 7% VAT. It rounds half-up once, at the end, and returns an integer.

I checked the output against hand calculations:

| Case | Result (satang) |
|---|---|
| 370 baht, non-member (no discount, VAT only) | 39590 |
| 370 baht, member | 35631 |
| 600 baht, member (5% then 10% then VAT) | 54891 |
| Exactly 500 baht, non-member | 50825 |
| Empty cart | 0 |
| 499.99 baht, non-member | 53499 |

Choices I made where the spec was open:
- **Member discount is applied after the bulk discount, not added to it.** "ลดอีก" reads as "a further 10%", so I compounded them.
- **The 500-baht threshold is checked on the subtotal before the member discount.**
- **Rounding happens once, at the end, half-up.** Rounding after each step would give slightly different results.
- **Invalid input raises `ValueError`:** a negative price, or a qty below 1.
